# Data Dictionary

```{r misc-setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{=latex}
\begin{adjustwidth}{-2cm}{-2cm}
```

```{r tbl-data-dictionary}

dict <- read_csv("data_dictionary.csv")

dict_tbl <- dict %>%
    kable(
        caption = "Data dictionary describing features used in modelling",
        na = "-",
        format = "latex",
        longtable = TRUE,
        booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
        latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header"),
        font_size = 8
    ) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "3.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "2.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(3, width = "1.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(4, width = "7cm")


dict_tbl
```
